results.answer: Use the command `srecode-insert` with a template name, or press `C-c / /` to insert a template whose name is typed into the minibuffer. This will trigger the expansion of a snippet template at the cursor position [4] or [5] respectively. The key binding `C-c / /` is the primary way to insert a template [5] and is specifically designed for this purpose. Thus, pressing `C-c / /` will allow you to expand a snippet template at the cursor. [5]
